text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the morning of New Year's Day, I receive an unexpected message from Seiun Sky asking me to come on her first shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are. Happy New Year!
choice_data_list: What's up with the sudden invite?
What's up with the sudden invite?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "What's up"? That's a little rude, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with a racer inviting her trainer to a shrine so they can pray for a successful year?
choice_data_list: Sure, that might convince me if you were a normal racer, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Are you saying I'm not normal? You are being rude!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I was just thinking we should use every tool we can get our hands on, including prayers—that's all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …That's what I mean. We're gonna have to use our heads, otherwise I won't make it through my senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky faced off against some powerful opponents in both the Classics and the Arima Kinen. I can assume she's been brewing up lots of different ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What should I pray for?
choice_data_list: Pray that she refrains from overworking herself.
Pray that she achieves great success.
Pray that she can enjoy her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A runner's body is an important asset. I pray that Seiun Sky will be able to keep on challenging herself without getting hurt in the process.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her true strength will matter more than ever this year. I pray that Seiun Sky will be able to make the most of her talents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pray that Seiun Sky will be able to truly enjoy racing this year, just like she did last year.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Okay. It's up to the gods now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's a secret. If I tell you, it won't come true, duh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But… I'm pretty sure we both wished for the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us then make our way back to campus while having a lighthearted discussion about the year ahead, when…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sei! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Special Week. She announced the other day that she would be racing in the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Morning. Getting in some solo training? You're sure not wasting any time this year.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yep! That's 'cause I don't wanna lose to you this year!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I saw you at the Arima Kinen. You were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You must have been under so much pressure, but you overcame it and ran exactly how you wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I got chills watching! So I've really gotta get better too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wanna beat you in the spring Tenno Sho. Once I do that… I'll be one step closer to being number one in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week's goals immediately clash with those of Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Well, thanks, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Good luck with your training. Let's get going, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna get in the way of her training. We can always chat more at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Plus, you heard her. She said she's gotta get better.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: She watched the Arima Kinen, so she must have felt how driven everyone was.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I'm…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm… hungry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Looking at Spe's face makes me hungry, y'know? Since she's always snacking on something.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I think I'm gonna go grab a bite from the dorm kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: See ya later. Here's to another year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Did Seiun Sky pick up on something I didn't? I can't tell right now, but I know I'll continue to look out for her and be a source of strength whenever she needs me.
